name: Gravity Spike
description: You release a pulse of chaotic gravitational force centered on a point within short (10 unit) range with a very short (5 unit) radius. Choose a direction. All medium and smaller creatures in the area are displaced 5 units in the chosen direction. If a creature has something they could reasonably grab to anchor themselves within range, they can make a coordination check against your spell check to avoid being displaced. If a displaced creature collides with a surface or terrain, they must make a fitness check against your spell check or take 10 physical damage. If you do not roll at least 2 successes, the direction of the pulse is random.
